item.title: One Tax Bahamas, Sex Crimes, CARICOM Election
item.ns0:title: One Tax Bahamas, Sex Crimes, CARICOM Election
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the government moves to address mounting questions over the upcoming "One Tax Bahamas" initiative as early registration for the new Bahamas Identification Number is set to begin. We also look at the National Security Minister's response to a deeply concerning uptick in sex crimes across the country, alongside the next phase of major labor law reforms aimed at strengthening worker protections. Plus, we bring you the latest on a newly released CARICOM election observer report and share details on an upcoming historic Caribbean tour by King Charles III and Queen Camilla. Join us for these stories, a check on back-to-school preparations, and your complete sports and weather report.
